name: Password Input
summary: Native password field with one value owner, a synchronized visibility action, optional text-backed strength feedback, and target-owned policy or scoring.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Positioning wrapper for the password field and visibility toggle.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.description: Sole native password value, validity, autofill, form, and reset owner.

anatomy.name: toggle
anatomy.description: Non-submit button that reveals or obscures the same native field.

anatomy.name: strength
anatomy.description: Optional new-password strength presentation with authored state and text.

anatomy.name: strengthBar
anatomy.description: Single segment of the strength meter.

anatomy.name: strengthText
anatomy.description: Required visible text whenever the optional strength presentation exists.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default password input and toggle size.

states.name: fieldHover
states.description: Pointer hover state that preserves the active validation family.

states.name: fieldFocus
states.description: Four-pixel zero-offset focus hierarchy on the native field.

states.name: fieldReadOnly
states.description: Focusable and submittable native secret that cannot be edited.

states.name: toggleHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on the visibility toggle.

states.name: toggleFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the named visibility action.

states.name: toggleDisabled
states.description: Unavailable visibility action when the whole field is disabled.

behavior.name: nativePassword
behavior.description: One native field preserves secret editing, autofill, validity, form ownership, paste, and reset behavior while Password Input owns its complete CSS surface per ADR 0074.

behavior.name: visibilityToggle
behavior.description: The target switches the existing field type and synchronizes pressed state, name, and icon without replacing the input, mirroring its value, or submitting the form.

behavior.name: strengthMeter
behavior.description: Optional new-password strength feedback is authored text plus decorative bars; scoring and announcement timing remain target-owned.

behavior.name: valueOwnership
attributes: value establishes the initial value in static HTML
live value or defaultValue in framework adapters
behavior.description: Visibility never creates a second value owner; static Web, controlled adapters, and uncontrolled adapters all bind the same native field.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation for the password value.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Initial native password value in static HTML; native Web owns subsequent editing and framework adapters may bind value or defaultValue.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Optional hint displayed while the field is empty; never a label replacement.

properties.name: visible
properties.description: Switches the field between concealed password text and visible plain text.

properties.name: strength
properties.description: Optional authored new-password strength presentation; none omits the meter.

properties.name: strengthText
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit strength presentation text when strength is none.
properties.description: Visible localized text that communicates the authored strength state without relying on color.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes the field and visibility toggle unavailable.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Marks the native password field as required; when a visible Field Wrapper label is composed, that label shows the standardized decorative marker.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: Keeps the secret focusable and submittable while preventing editing.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Native form field name used when the password participates in submission.

properties.name: autocomplete
properties.description: Native autocomplete purpose such as current-password or new-password.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit aria-describedby when no external guidance, strength text, or validation feedback is composed.
properties.description: Space-separated id references for external password guidance or validation; adapters append the optional strength text id.

accessibility: Use a native password input with a visible label.
Make the visibility toggle a button with a clear accessible name and pressed state.
Relate the visibility toggle to the unchanged native field with aria-controls.
Do not let the visibility toggle submit the form.
Expose strength feedback as text, not color bars alone.
Respect autocomplete values such as current-password and new-password and never block paste or password-manager autofill.
Keep read-only password values focusable and submittable while disabled values remain unavailable and omitted from form data.

web.notes: Canonical CSS owns the complete field surface per ADR 0074. The Web target binds visibility to the same native input; strength scoring and announcement timing remain consumer-owned.
